name: Timers
source: Ten years ago, the city where Chen Wendi lived was destroyed by a series of disaster, including earthquake, tsunami, tornado and meteorite. The government didn't know the cause of the disaster and regarded it as natural disaster. Chen Wendi's parents were killed by that disaster. Later he met a girl who called herself "the god of time" and admitted to causing the disaster. The girl also asked him to attend a trial to enhire the power of stopping time form her and Chen Wendi accepted that. Therefore, Chen Wendi got the power and strengen himself to revenge on the god. Ten years passed and Chen Wendi becomes a university student. He sticks to his belief until he met Wen Jiayi, a girl who has the same power as his.
translation:
十年前，陈文迪居住的城市遭遇了一系列灾害，包括地震、海啸、龙卷风和陨石，城市因此毁灭。政府不知道灾害原因，将其视为自然灾害。陈文迪的父母也在灾害中丧生。后来，他遇见了一名自称“时间之神”的女孩；她承认正是自己制造了灾害，并邀请陈文迪参加试炼，从她那里获得停止时间的力量。陈文迪接受了邀请，获得力量后不断锻炼自己，向神明复仇。

十年过去，陈文迪成为大学生。他始终坚持自己的信念，直到遇见拥有同样力量的女孩文嘉怡。
